title: FireGraphNet: Sub-daily wildfire spread prediction with directed graph neural networks
abstract: arXiv:2610.19191v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Wildfire decisions are made in hours, yet most learned spread models predict daily on targets including burned area. We propose FireGraphNet which formulates 12-hour growth as node classification on directed H3 graphs, with candidates ahead of the front and wind alignment, terrain, fuel continuity and barriers on edges. On satellite perimeters it achieves average precision 1.7-1.9x the strongest distance baseline on test California fires and 1.62x out of state. We show this skill comes from message passing rather than cell features or the aggregator, is highest on young fires in state, is carried deep along the wind by its edges, and is hidden by pooling. A convolutional network matches this ranking once trained on new growth, at worse calibration, so candidate construction, target definition, and aggregation shape conclusions about model skill. Editing fuel and barrier attributes reduces predicted spread more under guided than random pl

translated_title: FireGraphNet：基于有向图神经网络的亚日尺度野火蔓延预测
translated_abstract: 野火应对决策需要在数小时内做出，然而大多数学习型蔓延模型却以每日为预测频率，并以燃烧面积等为目标。我们提出FireGraphNet，将12小时火势增长建模为有向H3图上的节点分类任务，其中候选单元位于火线前方，边上包含风向对齐、地形、燃料连续性和障碍物等属性。在卫星观测的火线周界数据上，该方法在加州测试火灾中取得的平均精度（average precision）达到最强距离基线的1.7至1.9倍，在州外火灾中达到1.62倍。我们证明这一能力来源于消息传递机制，而非单元特征或聚合器；该能力在州内早期火灾上最强，并依靠其边属性沿风向向远处传递，且会被池化操作所掩盖。一个卷积网络在用新增火势数据训练后也能达到相似的排序性能，但校准效果较差，因此候选集构建、目标定义和聚合方式都会影响关于模型能力的结论。对燃料和障碍物属性进行修改时，在有引导的设置下比随机设置更能减少预测的蔓延范围。
tldr: FireGraphNet将12小时野火蔓延预测建模为带风向、地形、燃料与障碍物边特征的有向H3图上的节点分类任务，平均精度达到最强距离基线的1.7至1.9倍，且性能提升主要来自沿风向的消息传递机制。
en_tdlr: FireGraphNet formulates 12-hour wildfire spread prediction as node classification on directed H3 graphs with wind, terrain, fuel, and barrier edge features, achieving 1.7–1.9x the average precision of the strongest distance baseline, with gains driven by message passing along wind-aligned edges.
